scope_rules: Only explicitly enumerated current v03 source, preimages, reviews and read-only predecessor snapshots.
Original actual bytes enter only through the two finite preservation indices; exact path/hash/size are verified and overlaps deduplicated.

static_json_scan.method: Independent stdlib data traversal using the reviewed exact public shapes; no adapter or publisher execution.
